gancho: Two great Hawaiian gods are thirsty in the mountains. Kanaloa says, "Let it be seen!" and Kāne drives his staff into the rock. Water bursts out, and the spring is still called the water of Kāne and Kanaloa. This is the Hawaiian story of the first springs.
